_note: Casting + line direction for ElevenLabs eleven_v3. Tags in [brackets] are performance directions, not spoken. 'window' = seconds available in the timeline (takes may run a little longer).

lines.text: [whispers, frightened] Door two... [shaky breath] it just opened. [barely audible] Nobody touched it.
lines.subtitle: Door two... it just opened. Nobody touched it.

lines.text: [sharp, urgent] Don't touch anything. [firm, commanding] Fall back to the exit. Now!
lines.subtitle: Don't touch anything. Fall back to the exit. Now!

lines.text: [breathing hard] Feed's back... [whispers, uneasy] it moved.
lines.subtitle: Feed's back... it moved.

lines.text: [whispers, voice shaking] Again... [gasps] it's under the sedan.
lines.subtitle: Again... it's under the sedan.

lines.text: [urgent] Every time the feed drops, it gets closer. [shouting] Get out. Now!
lines.subtitle: Every time the feed drops, it gets closer. Get out. Now!
